# Turfli - Luxury Lawns and Greens, LLC

> Turfli is a luxury outdoor living contractor based in Scottsdale, Arizona. It designs and builds backyard remodels, artificial turf, putting greens, pet turf, pergolas, outdoor kitchens, pavers and patios, fire features, landscape lighting and desert landscaping for homeowners in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Fountain Hills, Phoenix and the surrounding Arizona communities. Design consultations are free; construction projects are paid services.

Website: https://turfli.com/
Phone: (480) 405-0725
Location: Scottsdale, Arizona, USA
Book a design consultation: https://link.turfli.com/widget/bookings/alliyah-margie-personal-calendar-ze9id7orh
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/turfliluxurylawns/

## Services
- [3D Landscape Renderings Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/3d-landscape-renderings/): 3D landscape renderings in Scottsdale — see your complete backyard transformation before construction begins. Included with all Turfli design-build projects. No commitment to see the rendering.
- [Artificial Turf Installation Phoenix & Scottsdale Metro](https://turfli.com/services/artificial-turf-installation/): Premium artificial turf installation in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley & Phoenix Metro. Smartscape certified, installation warranty, proper base & drainage. ROC licensed. Get a free quote.
- [Backyard Remodels Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/backyard-remodels/): Full backyard remodels in Scottsdale and Paradise Valley. Turfli is a design-build outdoor living contractor — turf, pavers, outdoor kitchens, pergolas, putting greens. Get a free quote.
- [Desert Landscaping Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/desert-landscaping/): Expert desert landscaping in Scottsdale & Paradise Valley. Native plants, decomposed granite, boulders, and drought-tolerant design. Smartscape certified. ROC licensed. Free consultation.
- [Fire Pits & Outdoor Grills Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/fire-pits-grills/): Custom fire pits, gas fire features, and built-in grills in Scottsdale & Paradise Valley. Gas and wood-burning options. ROC licensed. Free design consultation.
- [Landscape Design Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/landscape-design/): Custom landscape design in Scottsdale and Paradise Valley. 3D renderings, full design-build service, zero coordination headaches. ROC licensed. Get a free consultation.
- [Landscape Lighting Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/landscape-lighting/): Custom landscape lighting design and installation in Scottsdale & Paradise Valley. Low-voltage LED uplighting, path lights, and accent systems. ROC licensed. Free consultation.
- [Outdoor Kitchens Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/outdoor-kitchens/): Custom outdoor kitchens and BBQ islands in Scottsdale & Paradise Valley. Built-in grills, pizza ovens, bars, masonry construction. ROC licensed. Free design consultation.
- [Pavers & Patios Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/pavers-patios/): Custom paver patios, pool decks, and driveways in Scottsdale & Paradise Valley. Travertine, concrete, natural stone. Proper base, proper drainage. ROC licensed. Free quote.
- [Pergolas & Shade Structures Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/pergolas-shade-structures/): Custom pergolas and shade structures in Scottsdale & Paradise Valley. Alumawood, steel, and wood designs — permitted, engineered, beautiful. ROC licensed. Free consultation.
- [Pet Turf Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/pet-turf/): Pet-safe artificial turf for dogs in Scottsdale & Phoenix Metro. Odor-control infill, odor control, quick-drain base. Pet-safe, cool, and easy to clean. ROC licensed. Free quote.
- [Backyard Putting Greens Scottsdale AZ](https://turfli.com/services/putting-greens/): Custom backyard putting greens in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley & North Scottsdale. Multi-hole layouts, Tigerturf surfaces, chipping areas & sand traps. ROC licensed. Free quote.
